title: The entrance to the ruins opens
next_chapter_hook: An odd gleam flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, a depth of light that set alarm bells ringing in his heart—her awakening level had already exceeded all his expectations.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form dissolved like残snow beneath the moonlight, and his final words, 'The entrance to Chen Xuan's ruins has manifested,' still echoed in his ears. Before Chen Ji could fully process this, an extremely fierce pressure descended from beyond the nine heavens. It was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye—impassive yet vast, like the heavens gazing down at ants, devoid of any emotion, yet causing an bone-deep chill to rise from the depths of his soul. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and he sensed imminent danger. Maintaining his pace, he darted into the valley's depths, guided by the lingering moonlight and Mo Xiansheng's spectral guidance.

At the valley's entrance, a blue-black boulder shaped like a crouching tiger lay across the path. Its surface was covered with mottled symbols, eroded by time until the lines were nearly blurred, yet still emanating an ancient aura that made one's heart palpitate. Chen Ji halted three zhang before the boulder. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve quivered slightly, as if sensing some kind of summoning. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm his racing heart, his gaze sweeping the surrounding terrain like a hawk. Mo Xiansheng had said the entrance to Chen Xuan's ruins was here, but before him there was nothing but this inscription-covered boulder.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) 'Invisible yet present, illusory yet real... Chen Xuan Senior truly left a trick in his formation design.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his right hand, his index finger pressing against the dimmest rune groove on the boulder. He didn't动用 the Tianji Record's foresight—every glimpse of the future cost 5 Heavenly Fate points, and he would never lightly exhaust his destiny's筹码 unless absolutely necessary. Ten years of lurking had cultivated another survival principle: observe with eyes, deduce with heart, trade minimum cost for maximum intelligence. A刺骨的冰凉 radiated from his fingertips, and the rune groove seemed to pulsate like a living thing. Chen Ji's eyes flickered, a knowing smile curling at his lips.

The runes began illuminating with ghostly blue light, spreading along the stone's veins. However, after merely a few breaths, the glow receded like ebbing tide, the runes returning to darkness. An invisible barrier凝聚 directly in front of Chen Ji, emanating a repulsive force. Chen Ji frowned slightly, testing a step forward—the barrier rippled, and a tremendous force rebounded, nearly sending him staggering backward. The formation's intensity far exceeded his initial estimate.

Chen Ji steadied himself, retrieving the Tianji Record Fragment from his sleeve. The yellowed pages fluttered in the night breeze, and the密密麻麻的 characters suddenly glowed golden, resonating with the runes on the boulder. His heart stirred—could it be that this barrier required not just finding the entrance, but a specific activation method? He scrutinized the fragment's contents and discovered among Chen Xuan's cryptic hints one sentence he had previously overlooked—'Blood is the key, the fragment is the guide; without both, this gate cannot be entered.'

dialogue.content: (Cold smile in his heart) 'So that's it... Chen Xuan Senior, even your remains don't forget to pose difficulties for those who come after.'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, biting his thumb until a crimson droplet fell into the circular indentation at the stone's center. The blood, upon touching the surface, was instantly absorbed like spring rain falling into a parched riverbed. Simultaneously, the Tianji Record Fragment spun from his palm, embedding itself perfectly into another rune array above the indentation. The dual authentication mechanism triggered, and the boulder trembled violently. The invisible barrier tore open like silk sliced by a blade, revealing a gap just wide enough for a person.

The moment the entrance opened, that gaze from the heavens intensified tenfold! Chen Ji felt invisible eyes piercing through the void, locking死死 onto him. That gaze carried no emotion, yet was more chilling than any hostility. The Heavenly Eye—it sensed the aura of Chen Xuan's ruins, it was warning, probing, examining this insignificant ant who dared touch forbidden knowledge. Sweat beaded on Chen Ji's temples, yet he forced himself to remain composed, returning the fragment to his sleeve, and walked step by step toward the fissure.

However, the instant before he crossed the threshold, a slender figure darted from the night, as light as a specter, appearing behind him without warning. Chen Ji's hair stood on end as he spun around, only to see a face achingly familiar—elegant features bearing a tranquility unsuited to her age, lips curved in a meaningful smile. Chen Ling, his younger sister, the one the Holy Sect had kidnapped years ago, still the greatest vulnerability in his heart.

dialogue.content: (Softly speaking) 'Brother, you've finally come. This door... I've been waiting for you for so long.'

text.content: Tempests surged in Chen Ji's eyes, yet his expression remained unmoved. He examined Chen Ling thoroughly, his gaze wandering over her form, searching for clues to determine if the person before him was genuine. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned Chen Ling appearing here, and no Holy Sect pursuers were in sight—how could his sister, who should be trapped deep within the Holy Sect, appear at this moment? Chen Ling seemed to read his doubts, extending her right hand to touch the fissure's edge. The ghostly blue light immediately softened.

The moment Chen Ling's fingers touched the fissure's edge, the entire barrier emitted a low hum. The originally narrow gap suddenly widened to over three feet. Chen Ji's pupils contracted, alarm bells ringing in his heart—the barrier showed no resistance to Chen Ling, even actively cooperating. What did this indicate? Chen Ling was not a hostage controlled by the Holy Sect; she shared some connection with these ruins that he had yet to fathom.

dialogue.content: (Tilting her head, an odd gleam flickering in her eyes) 'These ruins don't only recognize Chen blood—they recognize me too. Brother, do you want to know why?'

choice.prompt: Chen Ling's words hid too many unsolved mysteries, yet the ruins entrance had opened, admitting no hesitation. Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.description: Chen Ling's appearance was too abrupt. Before clarifying her true intentions, recklessly bringing her into the ruins' depths would be equivalent to inviting a wolf into the house.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute control over the situation
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Ling genuinely wishes to help, rejecting her could create rifts in the relationship

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze darkened slightly as he stepped back, creating distance from Chen Ling, his tone cold and indifferent as usual: 'Your origins are unclear, your appearance at this moment too coincidental. Before I understand everything, you cannot enter with me.' As he spoke, his gaze swept across the widened fissure, his mind racing—if she truly is Chen Ling, why would she appear at this critical moment? If she's an imposter, whose doing is this?

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择独自探索，暂时疏远陈灵

choices.description: Chen Ling's mysterious resonance with the ruins might be the key to unlocking deeper layers. Bringing her along increases variables but could also bring unexpected assistance.
choices.visible_cost: The complexity of the situation is increasing
choices.visible_reward: Unlocking the deep exploration route of the ruins
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling's true stance remains doubtful, which may bury hidden dangers in the future

text.content: Chen Ji stared at Chen Ling for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh: "We siblings haven't seen each other for many years, and we've become quite estranged. Since you have fate with these ruins, it's fine to enter together." With that, he stepped aside, leaving half a step for her to go first through the rift's entrance. This gesture appeared trusting, but concealed deep calculation—having her walk ahead allowed him to observe her reactions and, if necessary, be the first to enter or retreat.

choices.memory_label: 玩家选择接纳陈灵为盟友

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ling did not get angry. Instead, she nodded slightly, as if she had long anticipated his caution. She withdrew her hand from the rift's edge and slowly walked to Chen Ji's side, lowering her voice: "Does Brother still remember when we played in the back mountain behind the ancestral mansion as children? There was a stone chamber our father strictly forbade us from entering. I once peeked through a crack in the door and saw exactly the same runes as these ruins." Her voice was gentle, yet each word was clear.

dialogue.content: (Direct gaze at Chen Ji) "Before he passed away, Father told me that the Chen Family ancestors' complete contract with the Tianji Record is sealed within that stone chamber. The reason I was kidnapped by the Holy Sect is precisely because my blood carries the bloodline necessary to activate that contract."

text.content: A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, but layers of waves churned in his heart. If what Chen Ling said was true, then her existence was not merely his weakness, but the key to unlocking the complete secrets of the Tianji Record. But why did she appear at this precise moment when he opened the ruins' entrance? Where were the people from the Holy Sect? Countless questions surged through his mind. His fingertips unconsciously rubbed against the fragment in his sleeve. The Tianji Record grew slightly warm at this moment, as if transmitting some kind of warning to him.

A low rumble echoed from the depths of the rift, and the entire valley trembled slightly. Chen Ling swiftly turned to gaze at the dark entrance, her pupils reflecting the flickering spiritual light. Her tone suddenly became urgent: "The second level of the ruins is about to close automatically. The time left for us is running out. Brother, whether you believe me or not, you must make a decision now—I can help you open the path to the deepest part, but the condition is that you must let me participate in the final decision.

A strange glint flickered in Chen Ling's eyes, that glow so profound it set alarm bells ringing in Chen Ji's heart. Her awakening level had already exceeded all his expectations. How many more secrets was this seemingly fragile sister hiding? The gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye grew increasingly fierce, as if wanting to incinerate this entire realm. Chen Ji took a deep breath, rapidly weighing the pros and cons in his heart—the time limit on the ruins' entrance hung like a sword overhead, and the chips in his hand were far fewer than he had imagined.
